name: Manipulate Tech
body:
School transmutation; Level technomancer

CASTING

Casting Time ? 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one piece of unattended technology; see text
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none (harmless); Spell Resistance no (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You can briefly align your will to the circuitry or structure of an unattended technological weapon or a technological item with a usage entry, provided the target has an item level equal to or lower than your caster level + 3. The target can even have the broken condition. When you do so, you can cause the item to act as if you activated it without moving it from its space. If the target is a weapon, you can cause it to activate for the rest of your turn; you can use the weapon to make one ranged or melee attack against a creature in range, adding your base attack bonus plus your Intelligence modifier to the attack roll. If the target is a technological item with a usage entry, the item activates for the time listed in that usage entry. This spell provides any charges or ammunition used by your activation.
